title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE, REVERSE LUNGES, THEN HAMSTRING, FIGURE-FOUR, AND HIP-FLEXOR OPENERS. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE LEG HINGE FOR BALANCE, REVERSE LUNGES, THEN WE OPEN THE HAMSTRINGS, HIPS, AND FRONT OF THE THIGH. THAT CHAIR HAS FLATTENED YOUR BACKSIDE INTO A BLOODY CUSHION. WE FIX IT. MOVE.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. THAT INBOX CAN WAIT, IT'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. BACKSIDE WOKE UP, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS OPENED. GOOD WEDNESDAY. NOW GO SIT DOWN WITHOUT TURNING INTO A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT ABOUT HIP-WIDTH. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS, SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL SHOULDERS-HIPS-KNEES MAKE ONE LINE. PAUSE A BEAT AT THE TOP, LOWER WITH CONTROL. TEN REPS. DO NOT ARCH THE LOW BACK — THIS IS YOUR BACKSIDE, NOT YOUR SPINE SHOWING OFF.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE SETS. TEN. HEELS DOWN. SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE. HIPS UP TO A STRAIGHT LINE. PAUSE. LOWER. IF YOUR LOW BACK IS DOING THE WORK YOU ARE CHEATING, AND I NOTICE CHEATING.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. BACKSIDE IS ON NOTICE. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS, SEND THE FREE LEG STRAIGHT BACK AND THE TORSO FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE STANDING HAMSTRING AND GLUTE WORKING — LONG LINE FROM HEAD TO HEEL. RETURN TALL. SIX EACH LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. LIGHT FINGERTIP TOUCH ON A CHAIR OR WALL IF YOU NEED IT. NO ROUNDING THE BACK.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STAND ON ONE. HINGE. FREE LEG BACK, TORSO FORWARD. LONG LINE. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. A TIGHTROPE, NOT A BLOODY FALLING TREE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH LEGS WHEN READY. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER THAN YESTERDAY, I HOPE. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. STEP ONE FOOT STRAIGHT BACK, LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES ARE ABOUT NINETY DEGREES — FRONT HEEL DOWN, BACK KNEE SOFT TOWARD THE FLOOR. DRIVE THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. EIGHT EACH LEG. TORSO UPRIGHT. IF THE FRONT KNEE CAVES IN, SHORTEN THE STEP.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. STEP BACK. LOWER. FRONT HEEL DRIVES YOU UP. UPRIGHT. NO WOBBLING LIKE A DRUNK AT A BUS STOP. CONTROL IT.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: PLACE ONE HEEL ON A LOW STAIR OR THE FLOOR AHEAD, LEG MOSTLY STRAIGHT, SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS AND FOLD FORWARD OVER THAT LEG UNTIL YOU FEEL A GENTLE STRETCH IN THE BACK OF THE THIGH. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. NO BOUNCING. BREATHE INTO IT.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL UP. HINGE. FOLD. GENTLE. THOSE HAMSTRINGS HAVE BEEN SHORTER THAN A TEMPER SINCE YOU SAT DOWN. LENGTHEN THEM.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR STRETCH
exercises.cue: SIT ON A STURDY CHAIR OR LIE ON YOUR BACK. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE THIGH, JUST ABOVE THE KNEE. GENTLY PRESS THE CROSSED KNEE AWAY OR DRAW THE SUPPORTING THIGH IN UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH IN THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. EASY PRESSURE — NO FORCING.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE ON THE THIGH. OPEN THAT HIP. GENTLE. YOUR GLUTES JUST WORKED. NOW WE UNWIND THEM BEFORE THAT CHAIR WELDS THEM SHUT AGAIN.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL: ONE KNEE DOWN ON THE FLOOR (PAD IT IF YOU LIKE), THE OTHER FOOT FORWARD, BOTH KNEES ABOUT NINETY. TUCK THE PELVIS UNDER SLIGHTLY AND SHIFT FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH AT THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. KEEP THE RIBS DOWN — DO NOT FLARE INTO A BACKBEND.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HALF KNEEL. TUCK. SHIFT FORWARD. GENTLE. THAT DESK HAS SHORTENED THE FRONT OF YOUR HIPS LIKE A BLOODY DRAWN BOW. RELEASE IT.
exercises.speakDone: FRONT OF THE HIP OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
